briefing.headline: Anthropic Claude 4 launch intensifies multi-agent security race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases amid regulatory scrutiny. Multi-agent systems expose new attack surfaces while compute scaling continues unabated.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: Anthropic released Claude 4 with enhanced reasoning. OpenAI o4 and Google Gemini 3.5 compete on agentic tasks. Meta open-sources Llama 4.5 while xAI Grok-3 targets real-time search.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell clusters reach 100k GPU scale at Microsoft. TSMC reports record AI chip demand with new 2nm process ramp.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination failures trigger the first major AI incident before 2027?
